description.value: April Point Dining Room is the restaurant of April Point Resort on Quadra Island, offering guests spectacular ocean views from its dining room and deck. The resort, operated by North Coast Hotel Resort Ltd., is a destination property in Quathiaski Cove with fishing, whale watching, and kayak rentals rounding out the experience. Touring cyclists making the ferry crossing to Quadra Island will find this a scenic spot for a sit-down meal in season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms April Point Dining Room is part of April Point Resort at 900 April Point Rd, Quathiaski Cove, BC — matching OSM address and phone (+1 250.285.2665). The dining page explicitly states 'We are now closed for the season. Please visit us again next summer,' indicating seasonal rather than permanent closure. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: Dining room is currently closed for the season per website: 'We are now closed for the season. Please visit us again next summer.' Directory users should be aware of the seasonal operating pattern.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, established resort restaurant on Quadra Island with confirmed contact details and address. Seasonal closure is not grounds for exclusion.

wow_evidence: destination property in Quathiaski Cove with fishing, whale watching, and kayak rentals; spectacular ocean views
